Wyoming High School Tennis Scoreboard for September 8-12, 2026

David SettleUpdated: September 12, 2026
  • Share on Facebook
  • Share on Twitter
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 10:09
Instaread

It’s the final week of the Wyoming High School tennis regular season. Matches are spread across five days from Tuesday through Saturday. Week 5 of the 2026 season features teams finishing up conference duals before next week’s regional championships in Rock Springs and Gillette. Some are rivalry matches, plus a few make-ups because of previous weather postponements. Thursday and Saturday feature the most matches on the slate.

WYOPREPS WEEK 5 HIGH SCHOOL TENNIS SCHEDULE 2026
